items.title: Stefon Diggs: Sitting out practice, will be full go Thursday
items.text:
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Diggs won't practice Wednesday due to an unspecified issue but is expected to be a full participant Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Athletic reports.
